title: Lost in the Fog
author: James De Mille
description: "Lost in the Fog" by James De Mille is a novel set in the late 19th century, likely during the 1870s.
longDescription: The book revolves around a group of boys from Grand Pre School, particularly focusing on their escapades as they embark on a nearly whimsical voyage aboard the schooner Antelope.

authorInfo.bio: James De Mille (1833–1880) wrote Lost in the Fog. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
